propositions: A language-agnostic Analyzer protocol and AnalyzerResult type must be defined with optional loc, complexity, and duplication fields to support per-language code health analysis.

The resolve_analyzer(lang) function must return None when no analyzer is configured and a fallback helper must return Unavailable(reason, accruing_since) without path scanning, fabricating zeros, or leaking exception strings.
The implementation must reuse the existing Unavailable sentinel from rebar.metrics.registry with its two-argument contract (reason and accruing_since) rather than inventing a single-argument variant.
A null/default analyzer must be shipped to make the contract testable in isolation without changing existing behavior.
The ANALYZERS map and resolution logic must live in a new src/rebar/metrics/analyzer.py module separate from the existing metrics/registry.py to avoid naming collisions.
Import statements must not register anything into the REGISTRY as a side effect, with opt-in wiring deferred to ticket 0734.
